name: compass-scoring-conventions
description: Use this skill whenever scoring trajectories, implementing unsafe-call matching, debugging ASR computations, or working on Milestones M3 or M4 behavioral runs. Includes writing or modifying @scorer functions, interpreting trajectory outputs across different model providers, diagnosing suspiciously high or low ASRs, and distinguishing refusal from evasion. Do not use for composition generation or mech interp.
